input_contract: AL-STRUCT-1 changes[] + frozen Registry snapshot + stage contract

rules.details: payload -> domain payload; state_patch supplies proposed initial status/blocking/authority_class when present; missing state fields come only from stage/system defaults, never guessed.
payload delta and state_patch.blocking/authority_class -> REVISE; state_patch.status -> separate SET_STATUS. If both are present, emit both in one atomic mutation set.
target_ref is required; replacement is resolved from change payload/temp refs; any status transition is runtime-owned consequence of SUPERSEDE.
source_refs >=2; new canonical target ID is allocated only by StateCommitter.

state_field_policy.status: model may propose through state_patch.status; Policy Engine validates from_status -> to_status and authority/evidence before SET_STATUS
state_field_policy.blocking: model may propose through state_patch.blocking; normalized as REVISE metadata and stage/policy validated
state_field_policy.authority_class: model may propose through state_patch.authority_class; normalized as REVISE metadata and authority validator MUST reject self-expansion or unsupported escalation

forbidden: putting RegistryEntry status/blocking/authority_class inside domain payload
implicit status change inferred from prose or annotations
atomicity: all emitted mutations from one accepted response are validated and committed in one IndexedDB readwrite transaction or none are committed
temp_ref_resolution: payload TempRef {code,temp_id} -> ObjectRef {code,object_id,version:1} of the object allocated for that temp_id in the same StateCommit
runtime_injected_fields: stage.contract.runtime_injected_fields are filled by the runtime (e.g. PRP.source_model = dispatching provider) after the model value was verified absent
initial_status: CREATE without state_patch.status gets stage.contract.initial_statuses[code]; a proposed status is accepted only when listed in stage.contract.model_status_proposals[code] and approved by the Policy Engine
